title: 译林版初中英语 八年级上册（8A，新课标）
description: Yilin Press junior-high English 8A, the edition revised for the 2022 national curriculum standard and used in Jiangsu. Outline only: unit titles, topics, grammar points, language functions and short word lists; no textbook text. Speaking tasks are original to Speakwow. Theme categories (人与自我 / 人与社会 / 人与自然) are our own classification against the standard, not the teacher's book.
subject: english
standard: 义务教育英语课程标准（2022年版）三级

units.title: Friendship
units.topic: Friends and what makes a good friend

goals.text: Describe friends' looks and personalities
Compare people
Talk about making friends
Use comparative and superlative adjectives
Use the unit's key words in your own sentences: friendship, honest, cheerful, humorous, caring

units.title: School life
units.topic: School life in different countries; unusual schools

goals.text: Compare school lives in different countries
Express preferences about school
Make suggestions (letter to a head teacher)
Use comparing amounts: more/most, fewer/fewest, less/least
Use as ... as / not as ... as
Use the unit's key words in your own sentences: uniform, textbook, programme, international, vacation

functions: Compare school lives in different countries
Make suggestions (letter to a head teacher)
speaking_tasks: Compare your school with a school in another country
Suggest one change to your school

units.title: To be a good learner
units.topic: Learning to learn; lifelong learning; language learning

goals.text: Talk about learning methods and habits
Give advice on learning (e.g. language learning)
Describe a love of learning
Use comparative and superlative adverbs
Use reflexive pronouns
Use the unit's key words in your own sentences: learner, lifelong, successful, inventor, talent

functions: Talk about learning methods and habits
Give advice on learning (e.g. language learning)
speaking_tasks: Share how you learn English best
Give a friend advice on learning

units.title: Hands-on fun
units.topic: DIY and hands-on activities (e.g. paper roses, tie-dyeing)

goals.text: Give step-by-step instructions
Give advice
Describe a DIY activity (diary entry)

Use the unit's key words in your own sentences: DIY, handyman, tie-dye, fold, glue

units.title: Wild animals
units.topic: Wild animals and their protection (e.g. pandas)

Talk about ways to protect wild animals
Persuade others to take action

speaking_tasks: Talk about an animal in danger and how to help it

units.title: Seasons
units.topic: Weather and seasons; seasons around the world; Solar Terms

units.title: Safe and sound
units.topic: Emergencies and natural disasters; staying safe
